about.title: Maison Singhar
about.subtitle: Savoir-Faire & Heritage
paragraphs: Singhar represents the pinnacle of vintage luxury jewellery, where centuries-old goldsmithing traditions meet rare, hand-selected gemstones.

Each creation is meticulously cast in solid 18k and 22k gold, adorned with ethically sourced diamonds, unheated sapphires, and natural pearls. Designed to be cherished as heirloom treasures across generations.
